title: neurokey: a lightweight AI tool using passive keystroke dynamics for Parkinson's disease detection and monitoring
core_idea: NeuroKey is a lightweight, browser-based AI system that passively collects keystroke dynamics during normal typing, extracts statistical and temporal biomarkers (e.g., key hold time, inter-key intervals) via a modular Streamlit framework, and employs machine learning and deep learning models for non-invasive detection and longitudinal monitoring of Parkinson's disease in home and telemedicine settings with privacy-conscious design.
tldr: A browser-based tool that uses passive typing behavior and ML/DL to provide non-invasive, scalable detection and monitoring of Parkinson's disease for home and telemedicine use.
